{"reasoning":"Locate every Simple Note candidate for the dinner and establish yesterday’s exact time boundaries before inspecting note contents or Venmo transactions. The search API is documented and must be fully paginated.","code":"from datetime import datetime, timedelta

now = datetime.now()
yesterday = (now - timedelta(days=1)).date()
yesterday_start = datetime.combine(yesterday, datetime.min.time())
yesterday_end = datetime.combine(yesterday, datetime.max.time())

dinner_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=simple_note_token,
        query="dinner",
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    dinner_notes.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print({
    "yesterday_start": yesterday_start.isoformat(),
    "yesterday_end": yesterday_end.isoformat(),
    "dinner_notes": dinner_notes
})"}
